risingwave_sql: CREATE TABLE t0 (c0 BIGINT NOT NULL, c1 BIGINT NOT NULL, c2 DECIMAL(18,4), c3 VARCHAR NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (c0))
CREATE TABLE t1 (c0 BIGINT NOT NULL, c1 BIGINT NOT NULL, c2 DECIMAL(18,4), c3 VARCHAR NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (c0))

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW v_group AS SELECT q0.c1 AS c0, COUNT(*) AS c1, SUM(q0.c2) AS c2, AVG(q0.c2) AS c3, SUM(q0.c2) AS c3_s, COUNT(q0.c2) AS c3_n, MIN(q0.c2) AS c4 FROM t0 AS q0 WHERE q0.c2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY q0.c1
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW v_distinct AS SELECT DISTINCT q0.c1 AS c0, q0.c3 AS c1 FROM t1 AS q0

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW v_topk AS SELECT c0, c1, c2, c3 FROM (SELECT q0.c0 AS c0, q0.c1 AS c1, q0.c2 AS c2, q0.c3 AS c3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY q0.c1 ORDER BY q0.c2 ASC NULLS LAST, q0.c0 ASC NULLS LAST, q0.c1 ASC NULLS LAST, q0.c2 ASC NULLS LAST, q0.c3 ASC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM t0 AS q0) AS qt WHERE rn <= 2
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW v_join AS SELECT ql.c0 AS c0, ql.c1 AS c1, ql.c2 AS c2, qr.c0 AS c3, qr.c1 AS c4, qr.c3 AS c5 FROM t0 AS ql JOIN t1 AS qr ON ql.c1 = qr.c1
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW v_ljoin AS SELECT ql.c0 AS c0, ql.c1 AS c1, ql.c2 AS c2, qr.c0 AS c3, qr.c1 AS c4, qr.c3 AS c5 FROM t0 AS ql LEFT JOIN t1 AS qr ON ql.c1 = qr.c1
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW v_stacked AS SELECT ql.c1 AS c0, COUNT(*) AS c1, SUM(ql.c2) AS c2 FROM t0 AS ql JOIN t1 AS qr ON ql.c1 = qr.c1 GROUP BY ql.c1
